reason: Anti-betrayal: {n} removals in a short time
title: 🚨 Anti-betrayal — {title}
action_unmod: 🛡 They were removed from the moderators.
action_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode: nothing was done, only reported.
why_setting: The response is set to «alert only».
why_creator: They are the creator — nobody can demote the creator.
why_not_via_aegis: They were appointed outside Aegis, and Telegram lets a bot demote only admins it promoted. Demote them yourself.
denied: Only the creator and Full-access admins with the needed Telegram right can do this.
restored: ↩️ Admin restored with their former rights.
panel_intro: Stops an admin who removes members or demotes admins too fast — a hijacked account or a betrayal.
p_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode is on: incidents are only reported.
p_limits: ℹ️ Telegram lets Aegis demote only admins it appointed itself; for the creator and admins appointed elsewhere it can only alert. Removals are seen as Telegram reports them to Aegis (it must be an admin here).
